body: We should also adopt Infra conventions.

When writing https://github.com/jsdom/whatwg-mimetype/blob/main/lib/sniff.js I came up with the following flow, which I think makes it clearer:

- [`computedMIMEType`](https://github.com/jsdom/whatwg-mimetype/blob/76b29fb2635157c72a68bf9fa44d32b890bc655c/lib/sniff.js#L676-L688) is the main entry point.
  - Corresponds to the spec's [computed MIME type / "MIME type sniffing algorithm"](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#determining-the-computed-mime-type-of-a-resource)
  - Arguments:
    - resource bytes
    - `Content-Type` header value (as bytes), for the HTTP(S) case
    - any other provided MIME type (as a MIME type record), for the non-HTTP(S) case
    - noSniff boolean (optional)
    - an "is supported by the user agent" predicate, used for image/audio/video (optional)
  - Return value: a MIME type record (never null or undefined or failure)
- An internal algorithm [`detectSuppliedMIMEType`](https://github.com/jsdom/whatwg-mimetype/blob/76b29fb2635157c72a68bf9fa44d32b890bc655c/lib/sniff.js#L657)
  - Corresponds to the spec's [supplied MIME type detection algorithm](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#supplied-mime-type-detection-algorithm)
  - Arguments:
    - `Content-Type` header value (as bytes), for the HTTP(S) case
    - any other provided MIME type (as a MIME type record), for the non-HTTP(S) case
  - Return value: a tuple of
    - suppliedMIMEType: a MIME type record or null
    - checkForApacheBug: a Boolean
- An internal algorithm [`identifyAnUnknownMIMEType`](https://github.com/jsdom/whatwg-mimetype/blob/76b29fb2635157c72a68bf9fa44d32b890bc655c/lib/sniff.js#L579)
  - Corresponds to the spec's [rules for identifying an unknown MIME type](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#rules-for-identifying-an-unknown-mime-type). (Which confusingly has a prefix saying that it will determine the computed MIME type, but this isn't really true.)
  - Arguments:
    - resource header (a subset of the original resource bytes)
    - scriptSniffable boolean
  - Return value: a MIME type essence (although a MIME type record would work just as well)
- Several other internal algorithms that are just resource header -> MIME type essence: `distinguishTextOrBinary`, `matchImageType`, `matchAudioOrVideoType`.

One point I found initially quite confusing was whether the "rules for identifying an unknown MIME type" were a first-class algorithm that external specs might use, or just an internal algorithm. I eventually realized the latter was the case, but the spec does not make this clear.
I think all of the following would be closed by such a rewrite: #194, #181, #145, #127, #102, #96, #74, #10, maybe #49.
